title: InterQ-RL: Interaction-Aware Correction of Execution Mismatch in Quantized Agentic RL
abstract: arXiv:2610.35303v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multi-turn agent reinforcement learning (RL) relies on long closed-loop rollouts, making generation and KV-cache costs a major bottleneck. Quantized rollout reduces these costs, but its low-precision executor also serves as the behavior policy and can induce execution mismatch with the learner. Existing quantized-RL methods are designed primarily for single-turn generation. They align the learner forward with quantized rollout or correct the current-token rollout-learner ratio, without modeling the policy history that produces each agent state. Even after quantization alignment, residual rollout-learner mismatch accumulates along the state-reaching policy history, so a current action may look locally aligned despite a mismatched history. We introduce InterQ-RL (Interaction-aware Quantized Reinforcement Learning) to correct this post-alignment mismatch. It applies bounded execution-prefix correction over the state-reaching policy history,

translated_title: InterQ-RL：量化智能体强化学习中交互感知的执行不匹配校正
translated_abstract: 多轮智能体强化学习（RL）依赖长闭环 rollout，使生成与 KV-cache 成本成为主要瓶颈。量化 rollout 可以降低这些成本，但其低精度执行器同时充当行为策略，可能引发与学习器之间的执行不匹配。现有的量化 RL 方法主要针对单轮生成设计，它们将学习器前向计算与量化 rollout 对齐，或校正当前 token 的 rollout-学习器比率，却没有对产生每个智能体状态的策略历史进行建模。即使经过量化对齐，残留的 rollout-学习器不匹配仍会沿着到达状态的策略历史不断累积，因此在历史不匹配的情况下，当前动作在局部上看似是对齐的。我们提出 InterQ-RL（交互感知量化强化学习）来校正这种对齐后的不匹配。它对到达状态的策略历史施加有界的执行前缀校正，（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: InterQ-RL 针对量化智能体强化学习中残留的 rollout-学习器执行不匹配问题，提出通过对到达状态的策略历史施加有界执行前缀校正来修复对齐后仍存在的不匹配。
en_tdlr: InterQ-RL corrects the residual execution mismatch between quantized rollout and the learner in multi-turn agentic RL by applying bounded, interaction-aware execution-prefix correction over the state-reaching policy history.
